sentences.en: He moved his leg so that it was touching mine.
sentences.zh: 他移动了腿，让它碰到了我的。

sentences.en: Last night, we saw a touching film at the movies.
sentences.zh: 昨晚，我们在电影院看了一部感人的电影。

sentences.en: I felt as if a cold hand was touching me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得好像有一只冰冷的手在触碰我。

senses.zh: 接触；感动（touch 的 ing 形式）
